title: Computational overhead from representation-space targets
description: Computing prediction targets in representation space introduces about 7% slower time per iteration compared to pixel-space methods like MAE, though overall convergence is much faster.
canonical_description: computational overhead from computing targets in representation space

evidence.quote: Compared to reconstruction-based methods, such as MAE, which directly use pixels as targets, I-JEPA introduces extra overhead by computing targets in representation space (about 7% slower time per iteration).
